subject: Show input has changed when using actionButton

messages.author: 726815e70c374c3d
messages.subject: Show input has changed when using actionButton
parts: I'm using the actionButton approach highlighted here to control when server calculations are re-run.  When an input changes, I am looking for a way to display a message that alerts the user that the current inputs may be out-of-sync with the displayed charts/tables.  Using the example Stock Prices example, this would be akin to displaying a message on the page if the user changes the Symbol or Date Range inputs but has not yet clicked the Get Stock button.  Instead of displaying a message, another less desirable option would be to just clear/hide the output charts and tables when an input changes.  Does anyone know how to accomplish either of these approaches?
